models.name: flow96
models.description: Stage 5 generator (flow96) on steering core steer96
models.notes: The Stage 5 model (called v0 in the Stage 5b scorecard, and 5a in the Stage 6 brief). 0.77M-param denoiser, 4-step flow, 8000 steps on bulk_v1 at 96x72 on top of the frozen steer96 core. Opening share 0.125 at 300 steps -- the model the Stage 5 brief complained about. Selected: it was the incumbent before the overnight run and was kept.

models.name: flow96c
models.description: Stage 5b overnight winner (flow96c) on steering core steer96
models.notes: The Stage 5b overnight winner, kept by the frozen scorecard (eval_out/decision_v0_vs_flow96c.json, keep: true) and recorded as winner in docs/ENERGY-LEDGER.json. 3.19M-param denoiser (width 64 + self-attention on a 9x12 grid) with a 4-step self-rollout curriculum; 12000 steps trained at 64x48 on top of the frozen steer96 core, evaluated and played at 96x72 (fully convolutional). Opening share 1.015x real on the confirmation set, 0.758x on test.

models.name: flow96d
models.description: Rejected overnight candidate (flow96d), edge-weighted reveal loss
models.notes: NOT SELECTED: the frozen scorecard rejected it (eval_out/decision_flow96c_vs_flow96d.json, keep: false). Better on every short-horizon signal (lower flow loss, lower one-step sampled L1, doorway-reveal ratio 0.914 vs 0.770) but a 300-step opening share of 0.000. Excluded from the M cycle; play it with --model flow96d to see the collapse by hand.
